brand.body: Plan the cycle, visit healthcare professionals, take orders and follow your team, all in one place, in Arabic, French and English.
brand.tagline: The field platform for pharmaceutical laboratories.

forgot.title: Forgot your password

activity.readOnly: Nobody can edit or delete the log.
activity.secretsNeverLogged: Secrets and recovery codes never enter the log, only the method that changed.

lab.export_ready: {author}: the data export of {record} is ready
lab.export_requested: {author} asked for a data export of {record}
lab.text_put_back: {author} put a text of {record} back to the master

plan.values_changed: {author} changed the values of the plan {record}

settings.mail_tested: {author} sent a test email from Delorc's account

translations.labs_synced: {author} updated the texts of the labs

activity.typedNeverSaved: What was typed as a password or code is never saved.

attention.near_limit: {count} lab near or over a limit this month | {count} labs near or over a limit this month

channels.backToShared: Its own server settings are erased when you save: to use them again, they must be typed again.
channels.fromAddressHint: Central sends as "Delorc"; a lab on shared mode as its own name.
channels.lastErrorHint: Check the server with the lab, then send a test.

modeChoice.own: The lab's SMTP server. Its emails come from its own address.
modeChoice.shared: Delorc's account. From the lab's name, replies to the lab's email. Nothing to set.

modeHint.own: Sent through the lab's own server.
modeHint.shared: Sent through Delorc's account. Replies go to the lab.

channels.notSetHint: No account yet: emails are only written to the server log. Set it before the first lab signs in.
channels.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved password.
channels.passwordNever: Never shown again. Type a new one to replace it.
channels.passwordNew: Typed now; never shown again after saving.
channels.quotaReachedHint: Only sign-in codes and access links are sent, and still counted, until {date}. Add a feature change to give more.
channels.sent: Sent to {to} at {time}. Check the inbox, and the spam folder.
channels.sharedHint: Sends central's own emails, and the emails of every lab on the shared mode.
channels.sharedNotSet: Delorc's email account is not set yet: this lab's emails are only written to the server log.
channels.smsCentral: Central never sends SMS. Each lab will use its own provider, set on its Channels tab.
channels.smsLab: The lab will use its own SMS provider. Until then, sign-in codes by SMS are not available to this lab.
channels.usageHint: Emails per month from the lab's plan and feature changes. A test is not counted.

geography.activeHint: Inactive countries cannot be chosen for a new lab. Their places are kept.
geography.canDelete: Nothing is under it, so it can be deleted.
geography.communeDelete: Deleting it removes it from the library. Labs already created keep it.
geography.copyHint: A new lab copies these places. Labs already created keep their own list.
geography.countryBlocked: This country has places, so it can only be deactivated.
geography.exportHint: All its regions, wilayas and communes in one JSON file, the same format as import.
geography.fileHint: One JSON file with the country, its regions, wilayas or provinces, and communes. The country is created if it does not exist. To see the format, export Algeria and copy it.
geography.inactiveHint: Nobody can choose it for a new lab yet.
geography.name: Name
geography.onlyAddsHint: A place already in the library is never changed, so importing twice is safe.
geography.regionBlocked: This region has wilayas, so it cannot be deleted.
geography.searchCommune: Search a commune or postal code
geography.startsEmpty: The country starts inactive and empty. Add its places by hand, or import them.
geography.wilayaBlocked: This wilaya has communes, so it cannot be deleted.

labs.adminEmailHint: The access link is sent here.
labs.canRemove: This period has not started yet, so it can be removed. The days it cut from the period before are not given back.
labs.cannotRemove: This period has started: only its price and note can be changed.
labs.chooseLanguagesHint: Active languages only. Another language can be added later, from the lab's Texts tab.
labs.contactEditHint: Changing these does not change the first admin's account.
labs.contactEmailHint: Optional. A person to write to at the lab.
labs.countryHint: Active countries only. Its places are copied.
labs.cutWarning: This starts during the current period: the {plan} period will end on {date}, the day before.

data.deleteHint: Removes the lab's database, its files, its periods and its feature changes. This cannot be undone. The lab stays in the list as Deleted, and its slug can never be used again.
data.deleteReady: Ready: an export made after the suspension holds the final data.
data.deleteWarning: Its database, its files, its periods and its feature changes are removed now. Its exports stay until their days end.
data.emailTo: You get an email at {email} when it is ready.
data.exportHolds: The archive is prepared in the background. It holds:
data.exportsHint: One ZIP archive with every table of the lab as CSV, its files, and its central record. Prepared in the background; you get an email when it is ready. Each archive can be downloaded for the export days set on Settings.
data.holdsFiles: the lab's files (logo, and later receipts, images…);
data.holdsLab: lab.json: the lab's details, its periods and its feature changes.
data.holdsTables: every table of the lab, one CSV file each;
data.noSecrets: Secrets are left out: password hashes, second factor secrets, recovery codes and tokens are empty columns.

reason.export_expired: Export the data first: the export asked after the suspension has expired, its archive is no longer available.
reason.export_preparing: An export is being prepared. Delete is possible once it is ready.
reason.no_export: Export the data first: delete needs a ready export asked after the lab was suspended, so it holds the final data.
reason.not_suspended: Only a suspended lab can be deleted. Suspend it first from the header.

data.typeSlugHint: The button works only once the slug is typed exactly.

labs.daysLeft: Last day | 1 day left | {count} days left
labs.defaultLanguageHint: Among the checked languages. A missing text shows this language first, then French.
labs.deletedHint: Its database, files, periods and feature changes are removed. Only the exports stay, until their days end.

done.languages: No language copied. | 1 language and its texts copied. | {count} languages and their texts copied.
done.linkNotSent: Access link not sent: the email failed. Send a new one from the lab page.

features.clickHint: Click a change that is planned or running to edit or remove it. Past changes stay as history.
features.endsYesterday: This change is running: it ends yesterday and stays in the history.
features.limitHint: The plan gives {value}. Leave empty for unlimited, 0 for none.
features.removeHint: This change has not started, so it is deleted.
features.rule: A change wins over the plan between its dates. Without a change, the plan's value applies; a feature the plan has no value for uses its default. Nothing is blocked yet: each module adds its check when it is built.

labs.fieldsToFix: 1 field to fix before creating the lab. | {count} fields to fix before creating the lab.
labs.firstAdminHint: Gets the lab admin role. This is their account in the lab, not a field of the lab.
labs.frenchAlways: Always copied: a text missing in the lab's languages shows French.
labs.graceHint: The lab keeps working. Without a new period, it is suspended automatically the day after.
labs.graceTitle: The last period has ended. Grace period until {date}.
labs.languageEditHint: Among the languages copied into the lab.
labs.languagesHint: Only the languages chosen at creation were copied. Another one is added from the Texts tab.
labs.linkSent: A new access link was sent.
labs.logoHint: PNG, JPG or SVG, up to 2 MB. Without a logo, the lab shows its initials.
labs.name: Name
labs.noActivity: No activity on this lab yet
labs.noAdmin: This lab has no first admin.
labs.noneHint: Create the first one. It gets its own database, its places and texts, and a 1-month trial.
labs.notesHint: Seen only in the central console.
labs.placesHint: The lab edits its own list in Studio. Changes to the library do not reach it. The country cannot be changed for now.
labs.planHint: The current plan is chosen. Choose another to change the plan.
labs.priceHint: The plan costs {price}. Change it for a discount.
labs.pricesHint: Prices are for information. Invoices are made outside Delorc.
labs.reasonHint: Written in the activity log and shown on the lab page.
labs.resumeHint: People in the lab can sign in again. Its periods are unchanged.
labs.sendLinkHint: For when the 48-hour link ran out. Logged as a security action.
labs.slugHint: Suggested from the name. Lowercase letters and digits, 3 to 30. It cannot be changed after creation.
labs.suspendHint: Nobody in the lab can use Delorc until it is resumed. Nothing is deleted, and its periods keep running.
labs.suspendedAutoHint: The grace days were over. Nothing was deleted. Add a period that covers today and the lab is resumed at once.
labs.suspendedHint: Every request to the lab is refused. Nothing was deleted.

texts.changedCount: No text changed for this lab | 1 text changed for this lab | {count} texts changed for this lab
texts.chooseHint: Choose a language to edit its texts. A text changed for this lab keeps its words when the master text changes.
texts.putBackAsk: Take “{text}” again, and receive later master fixes?
texts.putBackEmpty: The master has no text here: the lab will show its fallback language. Put back?
texts.saveHint: Saved texts become “Changed for this lab”: master fixes will not replace them.

labs.title: Labs
labs.undoHint: If a step fails, everything is undone: no lab and no database are kept.
labs.whatHappens: What happens when you create it

will.database: The database {database} is created and prepared.
will.languages: {languages} and its texts are copied. Default: {language}. | {languages} and their texts are copied. Default: {language}.
will.link: {name} becomes lab admin and gets an access link, valid 48 hours.
will.weekend: The weekend starts as Friday + Saturday. The lab admin changes it in Studio.

languages.activeHint: Hidden from language choices when deactivated. Its texts are kept.
languages.addHint: No code and no deploy. Add it, translate it, then activate it.
languages.canDelete: No text is written yet, so it can still be deleted.
languages.cannotDelete: {count} texts are written, so this language can only be deactivated.
languages.frenchHint: French is the last fallback: it cannot be deactivated or deleted.
languages.name: Name
languages.startsMissing: All {count} texts start as missing. The language stays inactive until you activate it.
languages.title: Languages

plans.activeHint: An inactive plan cannot be chosen for a new lab. Labs already on it keep it.
plans.canDelete: No lab uses this plan, so it can be deleted. This cannot be undone.
plans.changesHint: A saved value applies at once to every lab on its plan. Nothing is saved while a cell is wrong.
plans.deleteBlocked: Labs use this plan, so it can only be deactivated.
plans.emptyHint: A lab needs a plan when it is created. Create the first one; the {count} features are ready.
plans.inactiveHint: Inactive: not offered when a lab is created.
plans.labsHint: No lab yet. A change to a value applies to every lab on the plan. | 1 lab. A change to a value applies to it at once. | {count} labs. A change to a value applies to all of them at once.
plans.limitHint: Leave a limit empty for unlimited. 0 means none.
plans.name: Name
plans.nameHint: Shown only in the central console. Must be different from the other plans.
plans.noneActiveHint: Show inactive plans to see them.
plans.priceHint: For information only. Invoices are made outside Delorc.
plans.startFromHint: Its values are copied, then you edit them in the table.
plans.startsActive: The plan starts active, so it can be chosen for a new lab at once.
plans.title: Plans and features

roles.inUse: {count} people have this role. Change their role first.
roles.name: Name
roles.onlyYourRights: You can only give rights you have yourself.
roles.protectedHint: This role passes every check. It cannot be changed or deleted.
roles.title: Roles

settings.exportDaysApplies: Applies to exports ready from now on. Archives already made keep their date.
settings.exportDaysHint: Days a lab's data export can be downloaded. Then its archive is removed.
settings.graceDaysApplies: Applies at once to every lab, because grace is worked out from the dates.
settings.graceDaysHint: Days a lab keeps working after its last period ends. The day after, it is suspended automatically.
settings.title: Settings
settings.trialMonthsApplies: Applies to labs created from now on. Trials already running keep their dates.
settings.trialMonthsHint: Every new lab starts with a trial this long on the plan chosen at creation.

topbar.languageHint: Saved on your account: the console and the emails you receive use it on every device.
topbar.search: Search a page or a lab…
topbar.searchHelp: ↑ ↓ to move · Enter to open · Esc to close
topbar.themeHint: Saved in this browser. System follows your computer.

translations.backupHint: The database is the source. Files are only a backup.
translations.chooseFile: Click to choose a JSON file
translations.exportHint: All languages and texts in one JSON file.
translations.importHint: Only adds what is missing. A text already in the database is never changed, so importing twice is safe.
translations.toCheck: French has a slot this text lacks. Check it.

usage.historyHint: Each past month keeps the limits it had, so a plan change later does not rewrite history. Accounts and storage are the last night's measure of that month.
usage.notMeasured: Accounts and storage are measured every night at 02:00.
usage.rule: Limits come from each lab's plan and its feature changes for that month. Amber from 80%, red at 100%. Deleted labs are not listed.
usage.title: Usage

users.deactivateHint: The person loses access at their next request. Their name stays in the activity log.
users.factorReset: The second factor has been reset.
users.linkHint: No password here. The person receives an access link, valid for 48 hours.
users.linkSent: The access link has been sent.
users.name: Full name
users.ownerLocked: Only an owner can change an owner.
users.title: People

errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.

sms.name: SMS channel

monthly_quota.description: Emails the lab can send each month. Counted from the 1st.

monthly_quota.description: SMS the lab can send each month. Counted from the 1st.
monthly_quota.name: SMS per month
